plan_summary: Install and configure nginx on Ubuntu 24.04 through a structured sequence of verification, installation, configuration, and validation steps.
assumptions: User has sudo/administrative access to the Ubuntu 24.04 system
System has network connectivity for package downloads

tasks.title: Verify System Compatibility and Prerequisites
tasks.objective: Confirm the Ubuntu version is 24.04 or compatible and validate required system resources
tasks.rationale: Ensures the installation will work correctly on the target platform before proceeding
tasks.expected_output: Confirmation that Ubuntu 24.04 is installed with sufficient disk/memory resources
success_criteria: Ubuntu version confirmed as 24.04 or compatible
At least 200MB free disk space available

tasks.title: Update APT Package Repository
tasks.objective: Refresh the package index to ensure latest nginx version is available for installation
tasks.rationale: Ensures we install the most recent stable version with all security patches
tasks.expected_output: Updated package lists ready for installation
success_criteria: apt update command completes without errors

tasks.title: Install Nginx Package
tasks.objective: Download and install the nginx web server package from official repositories
tasks.rationale: Core installation step that provides the web server binary and defaults

tasks.title: Configure Default Web Root Directory
tasks.objective: Set up the /var/www/html directory for serving web content
tasks.rationale: Provides a location where website files can be placed and served

tasks.title: Create Default Server Block Configuration
tasks.objective: Configure basic nginx server block in sites-available/ or sites-enabled/
tasks.rationale: Defines how nginx handles incoming HTTP requests and routes traffic
tasks.expected_output: Functional server block configuration file created
success_criteria: Server block syntax is valid (nginx -t passes)
Root directive points to correct web root

tasks.title: Configure Nginx Service Management
tasks.objective: Enable and start the nginx service for automatic startup at boot
tasks.rationale: Ensures nginx runs persistently and starts automatically after system reboots
tasks.expected_output: Nginx service is active and enabled

tasks.title: Test Nginx Functionality
tasks.objective: Validate nginx is responding correctly to HTTP requests
tasks.rationale: Confirms the installation and configuration work together properly
tasks.expected_output: Successful HTTP response from localhost/defined host

tasks.title: Configure Firewall Rules for Nginx
tasks.objective: Allow HTTP/HTTPS traffic through the system firewall
tasks.rationale: Ensures nginx is accessible from external networks while maintaining security
success_criteria: Port 80 is open for TCP traffic
